title: Product
description: Canonical product schema v1 (SIE-24). The output of voice-to-product and image-to-product extraction: creates or updates a catalog item. Price history and full catalog-item fields (beyond name/unit/price) are a catalog-service concern, not part of this extraction contract.

confidence.description: Extractor confidence for this field, 0 (no confidence) to 1 (certain). Absent for manually-entered fields.

catalogItemId.description: Present when this extraction matches an existing catalog item (update). Null when it's a new item (create).

unit.description: Free-form unit of measure, same convention as the order schema's item.unit.

price.description: Current unit price in VND. v1 only ever populates whole VND (no subunit).

sourceLanguage.description: Language of the capture (voice or scanned text). Not applicable, but still required, for manual entry; set to the UI language.
